name: Scripting layer: blocks and templates
summary: Build what happens in your scene with simple blocks like 'When a guest enters Doorway, play beats Greeting, wait 2 seconds, seat them in Chair 1'. The blocks write real code you can read and change.
helps: Make doors that greet, bells that ring, chairs that welcome and music that follows people, without writing code, and move on to code when you want more.

d2: Open the Scripts tab and find Blocks.
Press a template, such as Greeting at the door.
Change the wait, or the beats it plays.
Turn Scripts on, then press Test it with me.
vr: Open the wrist menu and press Objects, then Scripts.
Walk into the door box and watch the greeting play.
use: scripts never run when a scene opens
turning Scripts off stops everything and puts it back
the blocks write code you can read
if you edit the code, the blocks turn grey
Test it with me sends a pretend visitor through
visitor counts are off unless you turn them on.

changes.note: You can now build scripts from blocks and start from five templates, so open the Scripts tab, pick a template, then press Test it with me.
